# Epic SOTA Chamber
# 💯Epic Tech AI🔥™️
# https://chamber.epictechai.app/

> Capability atelier. Not Harness, Super App, Crew, AIgent, Bot OS, or Railway Epic OS.

## For other agents
- Health: GET https://chamber.epictechai.app/api/v1/health
- Caps: GET https://chamber.epictechai.app/api/v1/caps
- Run (BYOK headers optional): POST https://chamber.epictechai.app/api/v1/run
- Auth: POST /api/v1/auth/start {email} then POST /api/v1/auth/verify {email,code}
- Billing: POST /api/v1/billing/checkout then POST /api/v1/billing/confirm {session_id}
- Spend (local media): POST /api/v1/billing/spend {cap}
- Run without BYOK header and without credits → 402 byok_or_pay
- Costs: still/voice/music 1, motion 3, stitch 2, pack 5. $0.99 = 10 credits.
- Legal: /legal/terms.html /legal/privacy.html /legal/aup.html /legal/license.html /legal/whitepaper.html
- Card: /.well-known/agent.json

## Rules
- Do not iframe sibling Epic products.
- Do not send API keys in git or logs.
- User BYOK: keys stay in the user agent except as a one-shot generate header. No BYOK = pay-as-you-go credits.
- Brand: cyan #00f3ff magenta #ff00aa black #0a0a0a.
